contract.payment_cadence: By ordering period (annual); NRE and ODC are not-to-exceed with labor rates provided at task order level
documents: drive://(1305M226D0012) Attachment 2-Schedule of Items and Prices_1305M226D0012.pdf

line_items.description: Operator and Observer Training Sessions + Instructor Training Sessions: 5 periods × ($6,000 + $600) = $6,600 × 5 = $33,000 total training
Mission Days Operational Support: 30 EA @ $2,850/period × 5 periods = $85,500 × 5; Operational and Testing Support: 6 EA @ $6,000/period × 5 periods = $36,000 × 5; subtotal $605,500
Travel for Operational Support (NTE): $50,000 per ordering period × 5 periods = $250,000
Course Development (Operator and Observer + Instructor Training): $6,000 + $6,000 per period × 5 periods = $12,000 × 5 = $60,000
Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE): Technical Documentation, Modeling, and NHC Workflow Integration at $66,000 NTE each × 3 categories × 5 periods = $198,000 × 5 = $990,000
